svg.title: Four deployment scenarios, four production-default quantization starting points
svg.desc: Enterprise LLM serving starts from a BF16 baseline and moves to FP8 W8A8 or W4A16 with Marlin-class kernels, adding FP8 KV-cache quantization for long context. Local and edge inference starts with a GGUF Q4_K_M or Q5_K_M file. Fine-tuning starts with NF4 and QLoRA, exporting to a serving format after merging. Diffusion pipelines use conservative per-component heuristics and visual evaluation. Every scenario still ships only after quality and serving benchmarks both pass.
